title: Reuters reports on Burford-backed ICC arbitration award against Cameroon
summary: Reuters reports on Burford’s counterparty, Sundance Resources, prevailing in an ICC arbitration against Cameroon, with a tribunal awarding approximately US$616 million in damages, interest and costs related to the Mbalam-Nabeba iron ore project. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Reuters reports on Burford’s counterparty, Sundance Resources, prevailing in an ICC arbitration against Cameroon, with a tribunal awarding approximately US$616 million in damages, interest and costs related to the Mbalam-Nabeba iron ore project.


[Read the full article here](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sundance-resources-says-it-has-won-616-million-cameroon-arbitration-over-iron-2026-07-27/) .
